tools.name: statuscake_list_uptime_checks
tools.description: List uptime checks with their current status (up/down), type, URL, check rate, tags and uptime percentage. Filter by status or tags. StatusCake: GET /uptime.

tools.name: statuscake_get_uptime_check
tools.description: Fetch one uptime check in full — settings, current status, last test time, next location and the monitoring servers it runs on. StatusCake: GET /uptime/{test_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_get_uptime_history
tools.description: Individual test runs for one uptime check — when, from which location, the status code and the response time (ms). Newest first; follow links.next (or pass before) to page back. StatusCake: GET /uptime/{test_id}/history.

tools.name: statuscake_get_uptime_periods
tools.description: The up and down periods of one uptime check — when each started and ended and how long it lasted (ms). The direct answer to 'how long was it down?'. StatusCake: GET /uptime/{test_id}/periods.

tools.name: statuscake_list_uptime_alerts
tools.description: Alerts triggered by one uptime check — when, the status it changed to and the status code. StatusCake: GET /uptime/{test_id}/alerts.

tools.name: statuscake_list_ssl_checks
tools.description: List SSL certificate checks with the certificate's validity window (valid_from/valid_until), issuer, cipher and score, and flags such as expired, broken, revoked or mixed content. StatusCake: GET /ssl.

tools.name: statuscake_get_ssl_check
tools.description: Fetch one SSL certificate check in full — expiry, issuer, cipher, scores, flags and any mixed-content resources found. StatusCake: GET /ssl/{test_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_list_pagespeed_checks
tools.description: List pagespeed checks with their location, alert thresholds and latest stats (load time ms, page size kb, request count, latest issue). StatusCake: GET /pagespeed.

tools.name: statuscake_get_pagespeed_history
tools.description: Past runs of one pagespeed check — load time (ms), file size (kb), request count, throttling and the saved HAR file location. StatusCake: GET /pagespeed/{test_id}/history.

tools.name: statuscake_list_heartbeat_checks
tools.description: List heartbeat (push) checks — jobs that must ping a StatusCake URL within a period — with their status, period and ping URL. StatusCake: GET /heartbeat.

tools.name: statuscake_get_heartbeat_check
tools.description: Fetch one heartbeat check in full, including its ping URL, period, status and when it last received a ping. StatusCake: GET /heartbeat/{test_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_list_contact_groups
tools.description: List contact groups — who gets alerted: email addresses, mobile numbers, integration ids and ping URL. Use their ids in a check's contact_groups. StatusCake: GET /contact-groups.

tools.name: statuscake_list_maintenance_windows
tools.description: List maintenance windows (scheduled alert silences) with their start/end, timezone, repeat interval, state and the checks or tags they cover. Only works on accounts using the newer maintenance-windows feature. StatusCake: GET /maintenance-windows.

tools.name: statuscake_get_maintenance_window
tools.description: Fetch one maintenance window by id. StatusCake: GET /maintenance-windows/{window_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_list_uptime_locations
tools.description: List StatusCake's uptime monitoring servers — region, region code, IPv4/IPv6 and status. Use region codes in a check's regions; use the IPs for firewall allowlists. StatusCake: GET /uptime-locations.

tools.name: statuscake_list_pagespeed_locations
tools.description: List StatusCake's pagespeed monitoring servers — region, IPs and status. StatusCake: GET /pagespeed-locations.

tools.name: statuscake_create_uptime_check
tools.description: Start monitoring a URL, host or IP. Returns the new check's id as data.new_id. Faster check rates and some regions depend on the plan. StatusCake: POST /uptime.

tools.name: statuscake_update_uptime_check
tools.description: Change an uptime check's settings. Only the fields you pass are changed; list fields (tags, contact_groups, regions, dns_ips) are REPLACED, and an empty list clears them. Pass paused=true to pause a check and paused=false to resume it. StatusCake: PUT /uptime/{test_id}.

tools.name: statuscake_create_ssl_check
tools.description: Start monitoring a site's SSL certificate for expiry and problems. Returns the new id as data.new_id. StatusCake: POST /ssl.

tools.name: statuscake_create_heartbeat_check
tools.description: Create a heartbeat (push) check for a cron job or worker: it goes down if StatusCake is not pinged within `period` seconds. Returns the new id as data.new_id; fetch it with statuscake_get_heartbeat_check to get the ping URL. StatusCake: POST /heartbeat.

tools.name: statuscake_create_maintenance_window
tools.description: Schedule a maintenance window that silences alerts for the given uptime checks (by id and/or tag). start_at/end_at are RFC3339; only the date and time are used and are read as local time in `timezone`. At least one of tests or tags is required. Only works on accounts using the newer maintenance-wind

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: statuscake_list_uptime_checks, statuscake_list_pagespeed_checks, statuscake_list_heartbeat_checks, statuscake_get_heartbeat_check, statuscake_list_contact_groups, statuscake_create_uptime_check, statuscake_create_ssl_check, statuscake_create_heartbeat_check, statuscake_create_maintenance_window · Private data: statuscake_get_pagespeed_history, statuscake_list_contact_groups · Public sink: statuscake_list_contact_groups, statuscake_create_uptime_check, statuscake_create_ssl_check, statuscake_create_heartbeat_check, statuscake_create_maintenance_window.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: statuscake_list_uptime_checks, statuscake_list_pagespeed_checks, statuscake_list_heartbeat_checks, statuscake_get_heartbeat_check, statuscake_list_contact_groups, statuscake_create_uptime_check, statuscake_create_ssl_check, statuscake_create_heartbeat_check, statuscake_create_maintenance_window · Private data: statuscake_get_pagespeed_history, statuscake_list_contact_groups · Public sink: statuscake_list_contact_groups, statuscake_create_uptime_check, statuscake_create_ssl_check, statuscake_create_heartbeat_check, statuscake_create_maintenance_window

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
